plain: Coming into a high office or throne, such as a king or a president does.

webster.text: A coming to; an acceding and joining; as a king's accession to a confederacy.

more.text: Increase by something added; that which is added; augmentation; as an accession of wealth or territory.
The invasion of a fit of a periodical disease, or fever.

example.quote: Elections in Ireland, till of late, were regulated entirely by the discretion of the crown, and were seldom repeated, except on the accession of a new prince, or some other contingent event.
